description:
Station Augments

Goes well with Station Refitting!

CAN BE ADDED TO A SAVE (USE SA_generateAugments AND SA_genSpecialContent COMMANDS) - CANNOT BE REMOVED

About

Adds station "augments" that drastically change the behavior and/or identity of your orbital station. Intended to be used alongside Station Refitting.

Augments can be found via salvaging, destroying augmented stations, or by purchasing them from a market. Augments do NOT dilute the loot pool, instead adding more loot in total.

Augments are also applied to NPC markets; they are either handplaced, or done through an autofit. Each faction has their own pool of augments that ensures a unique experience.

The entire augment system was designed with other mods in mind, meaning other mods can create their own augments and apply augments to their own markets without a hard dependency.]

Modding information
HOW TO INTERACT WITH STATION AUGMENTS AS A MODDER

How to... define a new augment
Create a new stationAttachment classCreate a new SA_station_augments.csv entry (see data>campaign>SA_stationAugmentSpec.csv for examples)It's pretty simple!How to... add an augment to a market
Either...Call market.addStationAugment() directly...Or...If the market exists after procgen, add a key-value pair of marketId to augmentId (as defined in the allAugments entry) to modSettings under "niko_stationAugments" and "MarketsWithAugments"Modsettings can survive invalid marketIds and augmentIds, but they will throw warnings.

Examples
Bubble shield: A massive shield that surrounds the station and protects it from harm. Doesnt block ships, but blocks projectiles. SAFETY OVERRIDES: Need I explain this one? Faster firerate, better flux, CR drain.KL-Pattern Shield Shunt: Shield shunt, but it gives the modules a damper field instead.Axial overclocking: Makes the station spin REALLY FAST.Economy conversion: Expensive, nerfs the stations in-combat performance, but adds +1 industry slot to the market.And more...

Compatibility

Can be added to an existing save, but you must run the SA_generateAugments and SA_genSpecialContent commands.

CANNOT be removed from an existing save.

FAQ

Is this mod balanced?

To the best of my ability, the cost of each augment is balanced to their strength. However, it cannot be denied that this mod makes stations substantially stronger - though the power spike is equal for all stations.

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/Station-Augments/releases/

Repo: https://github.com/nikothedude/Station-Augments

        High chance to spawn on diktat markets

            Fires a lot faster
            Can actually hit friendly ships and missiles

                Same deal as the weapon

                Ditto

            Defabrication Swarms
                Same deal as defabrication swarms
            Construction swarms
                Constructs a small garrison of threat ships

        Drops from threat battles
